items.title: obra/superpowers
items.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
items.author: obra
items.summary_zh: Superpowers 是一套面向 AI 代理的“技能框架”和软件开发方法论。它试图解决当前大模型在复杂任务中缺乏结构化思考的问题——通过定义清晰的技能单元和协作流程，让 AI 代理像人类工程师一样分步解决问题。这个框架不仅给 AI 用，也可以指导人类团队如何拆解需求、编写代码、进行测试。如果你在探索如何让 AI 更可靠地参与实际项目开发，或者想建立更高效的工程协作流程，值得关注。
items.summary_en: Superpowers is an agentic skills framework and software development methodology designed to make AI agents work more reliably on complex engineering tasks. Instead of letting a model guess its way through a problem, it decomposes work into defined skills, checks, and iterative steps—similar to how a senior engineer would approach a feature. The framework is practical enough to be used by human teams as well. If you're building AI-powered coding tools or want to inject disciplined structure into your development workflow, this project offers a fresh, actionable approach.

items.title: affaan-m/ECC
items.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
items.author: affaan-m
items.summary_zh: affaan-m/ECC 是一个面向 Claude Code、Codex 和 Opencod 等 AI 编程助手的性能优化系统，它集成了技能、直觉、记忆、安全性和研究优先的开发理念，帮助开发者更高效地利用这些工具，让 AI 代理的运行更加稳定和智能。
items.summary_en: ECC is an agent harness performance optimization system designed for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Opencod. It bundles skills, instincts, memory, security, and a research-first development approach, enabling developers to fine-tune their agents for better stability and intelligence. This matters because it transforms raw AI tools into more reliable, context-aware programming partners.

items.title: mattpocock/skills
items.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
items.author: mattpocock
items.summary_zh: 这个项目是著名 TypeScript 教育家 Matt Pocock 分享的一份“技能清单”，直接来自他的 AI 编程助手 Claude 的配置文件。它列出了他认为一名“真正工程师”应该掌握的核心能力——从代码审查、架构决策到技术债管理，覆盖了远比语法更重要的工程实践。与其说是代码库，不如说是一份工程文化的宣言。适合想提升团队工程水平或建立个人技术成长路线的开发者阅读。
items.summary_en: This is Matt Pocock's personal skill list for 'real engineers,' extracted straight from his Claude AI configuration. It goes far beyond coding syntax to cover code review, architecture decisions, tech debt management, and communication—the soft and hard skills that separate experienced engineers from beginners. It's less a codebase and more a manifesto on engineering culture. If you're looking to level up your professional practice or define what 'good engineering' means for your team, this concise list is a great starting point.

items.title: OpenCut-app/OpenCut
items.description: The open-source CapCut alternative
items.author: OpenCut-app
items.summary_zh: OpenCut 是一款开源的视频编辑工具，旨在成为 CapCut 的替代品。它完全免费，支持多平台使用，用户无需付费即可获得强大的剪辑功能。对于想要摆脱商业软件限制的创作者来说，OpenCut 提供了极高的可定制性和透明度，让视频编辑更加自由。
items.summary_en: OpenCut is an open-source video editor designed as a free alternative to CapCut. It offers powerful editing features without any subscription or watermark, making it ideal for content creators who want full control over their tools. The project is cross-platform and community-driven, ensuring transparency and continuous improvement. For anyone tired of paid video editors or restrictive platforms, OpenCut provides a flexible and privacy-respecting solution.

items.title: ocornut/imgui
items.description: Dear ImGui: Bloat-free Graphical User interface for C++ with minimal dependencies
items.author: ocornut
items.summary_zh: Dear ImGui是一个极简主义的C++图形用户界面库，几乎没有外部依赖，却能实现流畅的即时模式界面。它特别适合游戏开发工具、调试面板和实时数据可视化场景，因为开发者不需要复杂的UI框架就能快速构建交互界面。相比传统UI库，它更注重开发效率和灵活性，因此在独立游戏和工具链中广受欢迎。
items.summary_en: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free graphical user interface library for C++ with minimal dependencies, offering a seamless immediate mode GUI experience. It is especially popular among game developers and tool builders who need quick, interactive panels for debugging or real-time data visualization without the overhead of traditional UI frameworks. Its focus on simplicity and performance makes it a go-to choice for indie games and embedded tools.

items.title: koala73/worldmonitor
items.description: Real-time global intelligence dashboard. AI-powered news aggregation, geopolitical monitoring, and infrastructure tracking in a unified situational awareness interface
items.author: koala73
items.summary_zh: 这是一个基于AI的实时全球情报仪表盘，能够聚合新闻、监控地缘政治事件并追踪基础设施状态，用户可以通过统一的界面全面了解世界动态。它的价值在于为需要快速掌握全球局势的分析师、记者和企业决策者提供了强大的实时信息工具。
items.summary_en: Worldmonitor is an AI-powered real-time global intelligence dashboard that aggregates news, monitors geopolitical events, and tracks infrastructure status in a single unified view. Designed for analysts, journalists, and business leaders, it enables rapid situational awareness and informed decision-making by consolidating diverse data streams into an accessible interface. Its significance lies in simplifying complex global monitoring and helping professionals stay ahead of critical developments.

items.title: ComposioHQ/awesome-claude-skills
items.description: A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows
items.author: ComposioHQ
items.summary_zh: 这个名为awesome-claude-skills的项目整理了大量定制Claude AI工作流的技巧、资源和工具集合。它像一本实用手册，帮开发者快速找到扩展Claude能力的最佳实践，从提示工程到集成外部API应有尽有。对于想要让Claude更贴合自身需求的开发者和AI爱好者来说，这个资源库省去了四处搜索的麻烦，直接提供闭坑指南和效率提升方案。
items.summary_en: This curated collection brings together a wealth of tips, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows. Think of it as a practical handbook that helps developers quickly find best practices for extending Claude's capabilities, from prompt engineering to integrating external APIs. For developers and AI enthusiasts who want to tailor Claude to their specific needs, this repository saves countless hours of searching by providing ready-to-use guides and efficiency hacks.

items.title: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks
items.description: Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5, Opus 4.8, Claude Code, Claude Design. OpenAI - ChatGPT GPT-5.6, Codex GPT-5.6, GPT-5.5. Google - Gemini 3.5 Flash, 3.1 Pro, Antigravity. xAI - Grok, Cursor, Copilot, VS Code, Perplexity, and more. Updated regularly.
items.author: asgeirtj
items.summary_zh: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks 是一个 GitHub 项目，它收集了 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 多个大模型的系统提示词，包括 Claude Fable 5、Opus 4.8、ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking 等。这些提示词揭示了模型背后如何被引导、如何设定角色和限制，对 AI 研究者和开发者理解模型行为非常有价值。它引发了关于提示工程和模型安全边界的讨论，也是窥探顶级 AI 内部设计的一个窗口。
items.summary_en: This GitHub repository compiles leaked system prompts from popular AI models like Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Opus 4.8, as well as OpenAI's ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking and GPT 5.5 Instant. By exposing the hidden instructions that shape how these models behave, it offers rare insight into prompt engineering, safety guardrails, and role-setting techniques. AI researchers and developers can learn how top models are orchestrated, but the leak also raises important questions about access control and intellectual property in the generative AI race.

items.title: anthropics/claude-cookbooks
items.description: A collection of notebooks/recipes showcasing some fun and effective ways of using Claude.
items.author: anthropics
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 官方在 GitHub 上发布了 Claude 菜谱合集，里面包含一系列 Jupyter 笔记和实用示例，展示了如何用 Claude 做文本分析、代码生成、多轮对话等高级任务。这些菜谱不仅教基础用法，还挖掘了很多创意场景，比如用 Claude 写剧本或模拟辩论。对于想深入研究 Claude 能力的开发者来说，这是绝佳的学习资源。
items.summary_en: Anthropic has officially released the Claude Cookbooks on GitHub, a collection of Jupyter notebooks and practical recipes that demonstrate advanced use cases like text analysis, code generation, and multi-turn conversations. Beyond basic tutorials, these cookbooks explore creative scenarios such as scriptwriting or debate simulation. For developers looking to push Claude's capabilities, this is an invaluable learning resource.

items.title: Lordog/dive-into-llms
items.description: 《动手学大模型Dive into LLMs》系列编程实践教程
items.author: Lordog
items.summary_zh: 这是一套名为《动手学大模型Dive into LLMs》的编程实践教程，通过动手操作帮助学习者深入理解大语言模型的工作原理和开发方法。它适合想从零开始构建和微调大模型的研究者和开发者，提供了丰富的代码示例和实战项目。在AI学习资源中，它强调理论与实践的结合，降低了大模型的学习门槛。
items.summary_en: Dive into LLMs is a hands-on programming tutorial series that teaches learners how large language models work through practical coding exercises. It covers building and fine-tuning LLMs from scratch, making it ideal for researchers and developers seeking a deep understanding. The course bridges theory with real-world projects, providing extensive code examples and step-by-step guidance. By demystifying complex concepts, it significantly lowers the barrier to mastering large models for AI enthusiasts and practitioners.

items.title: 黄仁勋站在 AI 产业的十字路口呐喊：力挺开源
items.summary_zh: 黄仁勋在AI产业的关键节点上力挺开源，他认为开放合作是技术创新的核心驱动力，这一立场可能重塑行业格局，尤其为中小企业和开发者提供了更平等的竞争机会。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang publicly advocates for open source at a critical crossroads of the AI industry, arguing that openness and collaboration are essential for driving innovation. His stance could reshape the competitive landscape, particularly benefiting small and medium-sized enterprises and developers who rely on accessible tools.

items.title: OpenAI下一代模型，被曝8月提前上线
items.summary_zh: 爆料称OpenAI的下一代模型将提前至今年8月上线，较预期更早。这一加速发布预示着AI竞赛进一步白热化，新模型可能带来性能飞跃，对依赖前沿语言模型的开发者和企业产生重大影响。
items.summary_en: Leaks suggest OpenAI's next-generation model may launch as early as August, ahead of schedule. This accelerated release signals an intensifying AI race, with potential major performance improvements that could significantly impact developers and businesses relying on cutting-edge language models.

items.title: 被你质疑“不行”的燃油车，又杀回来了
items.summary_zh: 曾被唱衰的燃油车近期销量反弹，尤其在某些市场表现抢眼。这表明内燃机技术仍有生命力，尤其在长途运输和越野等场景中不可替代，挑战了纯电全面取代的传统叙事。
items.summary_en: Despite widespread skepticism, traditional fuel-powered vehicles are making a comeback with recent sales surges in certain markets. This trend demonstrates that internal combustion engines still have relevance, particularly in long-haul transport and off-road scenarios, challenging the narrative of an inevitable all-electric future.

items.title: 从太空高速冲回地球后，马斯克家最大的飞船，此刻正漂在印度洋上
items.summary_zh: SpaceX的星舰原型完成高速再入大气层测试后成功溅落印度洋，这是星舰开发的重要里程碑。此次测试为未来月球和火星任务铺平了道路，标志着马斯克星际旅行愿景迈出关键一步。
items.summary_en: SpaceX's Starship prototype successfully completed a high-speed reentry test and splashed down in the Indian Ocean, marking a major milestone for the program. The test brings Musk's vision of interplanetary travel closer to reality, with implications for future lunar missions and eventual Mars colonization.

items.title: 王虹 慢慢想
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章以王虹为主角，探讨其在创业或生活中“慢慢想”的哲学理念，强调在快节奏的时代里沉淀思考的重要性。这类内容常为焦虑的读者提供启发，鼓励他们以更从容的心态面对挑战。
items.summary_en: This article features Wang Hong, an entrepreneur or expert, who shares a philosophy of taking time to think slowly in a fast-paced world. It resonates with readers overwhelmed by constant pressure, offering a thoughtful perspective on patience and deliberate decision-making in both business and life.

items.title: 东方甄选闷声赚麻了
items.summary_zh: 东方甄选在直播电商热潮中闷声发大财，凭借董宇辉等主播的知识带货风格和自营产品体系，在抖音平台悄然实现了惊人的营收增长。这家由新东方转型而来的公司不仅摆脱了教培寒冬的阴影，更让外界看到了文化内容与商业结合的巨大潜力。对于关注新消费和直播行业的人来说，它证明了优质内容完全可以撑起一个商业帝国。
items.summary_en: Oriental Selection has been quietly raking in massive profits amid the livestream e-commerce boom. Leveraging the knowledge-infused hosting style of Dong Yuhui and a self-branded product lineup, the company transformed from a tutoring giant into a retail powerhouse on Douyin. It not only survived the crackdown on private education but thrived, proving that compelling cultural content can build a lucrative business empire—a lesson for anyone watching the new retail and livestreaming space.

items.title: 20斤一个的巨型西瓜，为何在中国绝迹了？
items.summary_zh: 曾经在街头随处可见的二三十斤重巨型西瓜，如今几乎在中国市场绝迹，取而代之的是几斤重的袖珍瓜。这背后是品种改良、物流成本和消费习惯演变的结果——大西瓜运输不便、一次性吃不完容易浪费，而小西瓜更适合家庭和小份量消费。文章追溯了这种从“大”到“小”的转变，折射出中国农业如何适应现代零售和生活方式。
items.summary_en: Giant watermelons weighing 20 to 30 jin (10–15 kg) were once a common sight on Chinese streets, but they've all but disappeared. Today's consumers prefer smaller, 3–5 jin melons. The shift reflects changes in variety breeding, logistics costs, and eating habits—large melons are hard to transport and often go to waste. This evolution shows how Chinese agriculture has adapted to modern retail and smaller households, a fascinating glimpse into the country's changing food culture.

items.title: 广西县城，即将跑出一个IPO
items.summary_zh: 一家来自广西县城的企业即将登陆资本市场，引发关注。这个IPO案例打破了“好公司只在一线城市”的刻板印象，说明县域经济同样能孵化出具备上市实力的企业。它靠的是当地特色产业和精细化运营，证明了在看似偏远的土壤上，只要找到正确的赛道，一样能长成参天大树。这对投资人和地方创业者而言是个鼓舞。
items.summary_en: A company from a small county in Guangxi is about to go public, challenging the stereotype that only first-tier cities spawn IPO-worthy firms. This case shows that county-level economies can nurture companies strong enough to list, thanks to local specialty industries and meticulous operations. It's an inspiring reminder for investors and local entrepreneurs that with the right niche, a business can thrive even in a seemingly remote area.

items.title: 买不起大疆、影石的年轻人，排队租运动相机
items.summary_zh: 越来越多年轻人买不起大疆、影石等品牌昂贵的运动相机和无人机，转而选择租赁服务。这种“以租代买”的模式让普通人也能在旅行、户外活动中体验旗舰设备，而不用承担数千元的购机成本。租赁平台因此生意火爆，甚至出现排队等货的情况。这反映出消费降级下，年轻人更追求“使用权”而非“所有权”，同时也催生了共享经济的新增长点。
items.summary_en: Young people who can't afford DJI or Insta360 action cameras and drones are flocking to rental services instead. By renting, they get to use top-tier gear for trips and outdoor adventures without paying thousands upfront. Rental platforms are booming, sometimes with waiting lists. This trend highlights a shift from ownership to usage among budget-conscious consumers, and it's creating a new sweet spot for the sharing economy in the outdoor tech space.

items.title: 江淮汽车，成了高端但“埋”了牛散
items.summary_zh: 江淮汽车近年通过合资和代工模式成功切入高端电动车市场，甚至成为蔚来的生产伙伴，品牌形象大幅提升。然而，这一华丽的转型却让不少押注其股价的资深牛散损失惨重——股价并未如期爆发，反而长期低迷。文章剖析了江淮在制造端的高端化与资本端回报错位的现象，提醒投资者关注车企转型中“叫好不叫座”的风险。
items.summary_en: JAC Motors has successfully moved upmarket by partnering with NIO and others to build premium EVs, raising its brand profile. Yet this impressive transformation has left many veteran retail investors (the 'bulls') nursing heavy losses—the stock price hasn't soared as expected and remains depressed. The story decouples operational success from market valuation, warning that even a company that 'makes great cars' can disappoint investors. It's a cautionary tale for anyone betting on automakers pivoting to high-end.

items.title: 腾讯云发布首个“流程原生”研发智能体 CodeBuddy NPC
items.summary_zh: 腾讯云推出了业界首个流程原生的研发智能体CodeBuddy NPC，它深度嵌入开发工作流，能在编码、测试、部署等环节自动感知上下文并提供精准建议。不同于传统聊天式AI，这个智能体像真正的队友一样理解项目全貌，帮助团队减少重复劳动、提升协作效率。对于追求敏捷开发的企业和开发者来说，这是一次从“被动问答”到“主动辅助”的范式升级。
items.summary_en: Tencent Cloud has launched CodeBuddy NPC, the industry's first process-native development agent that embeds directly into development workflows. Unlike traditional chat-based AI assistants, it understands full project context and proactively provides relevant suggestions during coding, testing, and deployment. This marks a shift from passive Q&A to active companionship in software development, promising to reduce repetitive tasks and improve team collaboration for agile teams and enterprises.

items.title: WAIC现场探展：从 Coding 到办公，AI 新物种出现了吗？
items.summary_zh: 在2025年世界人工智能大会（WAIC）现场，记者发现AI正在从代码生成扩展到办公全流程，出现了各种令人眼前一亮的新物种。从能自动写代码的助手到一键生成PPT的办公工具，AI不再是简单的聊天机器人，而是深度融入工作流的智能体。这些新应用正在重新定义“生产力”的含义。对于职场人士和技术决策者来说，这篇探展文章提供了最前沿的AI落地观察，帮你了解哪些工具值得关注。
items.summary_en: On the floor of WAIC 2025, reporters discovered that AI is expanding from code generation to the entire office workflow, producing exciting new species. From automated coding assistants to one-click PPT generators, AI is no longer just a chatbot but deeply integrated into work processes. These new applications are redefining productivity. For professionals and tech decision-makers, this on-site report offers cutting-edge observations of AI deployment, highlighting which tools deserve attention.

items.title: AWS Continuum 将为企业提供智能体代码安全解决方案
items.summary_zh: AWS Continuum 是亚马逊云科技推出的一项面向企业智能体的代码安全解决方案，旨在帮助开发者和安全团队在构建和部署 AI 代理时自动检测并修复代码中的安全隐患。该服务整合了静态分析、运行时监控和策略引擎，能够无缝集成到现有开发流水线中。对于正在大规模落地 AI Agent 的企业来说，Continuum 提供了从代码到运行时的全链路安全保障，有效降低了智能体被恶意利用的风险，让企业可以更放心地将自主权交给 AI。
items.summary_en: AWS Continuum is a new code security solution from Amazon Web Services designed specifically for enterprise AI agents. It helps developers and security teams automatically detect and fix security vulnerabilities in agent code during build and deployment. By integrating static analysis, runtime monitoring, and a policy engine, Continuum provides end-to-end security from code to runtime, seamlessly fitting into existing CI/CD pipelines. This matters because as enterprises scale their use of AI agents, the risk of code-level attacks grows. Continuum gives companies confidence to delegate more autonomy to AI while maintaining robust security posture.

items.title: Cloudera CTO：技术自主，始于开源架构
items.summary_zh: Cloudera 首席技术官在接受采访时强调，企业的技术自主能力必须建立在开源架构之上，而不是依赖单一供应商的闭源平台。他指出，只有通过拥抱开源，企业才能真正掌握技术演进的方向和定制化的自由，避免被锁定风险。Cloudera 自身也在积极推动数据平台的开源化，让客户能够自主管理数据和分析工作负载。这篇文章对于正在评估技术战略的企业决策者具有启发意义，尤其是那些希望在 AI 时代保持独立性和灵活性的组织。
items.summary_en: Cloudera's CTO argues that true technical sovereignty for enterprises must start with open-source architecture. In a recent interview, he emphasized that relying on proprietary platforms locks organizations into vendor dependency, while open source gives them control over evolution and customization. Cloudera itself is pushing its data platform toward greater openness, enabling customers to manage data and analytics workloads independently. This perspective is crucial for business leaders evaluating their technology strategy in the AI era, especially those who want to avoid lock-in and maintain flexibility. The takeaway: open source is not just a cost-saving measure but a strategic move for long-term autonomy.

items.title: 圆桌访谈：AI 产业进入新阶段了吗？
items.summary_zh: 一场汇聚多位行业专家的圆桌访谈，直击AI产业的核心问题：我们是否已经进入新阶段？嘉宾们从技术演进、商业化落地、投资趋势等角度展开讨论，有人认为大模型能力趋于收敛，应用创新将成为下一波主要动力；也有人指出行业泡沫尚存，真正有价值的应用才刚起步。无论观点如何，这场对话都为从业者提供了宝贵的决策参考。如果你在思考AI赛道的下一个方向，这篇文章不容错过。
items.summary_en: In this roundtable interview, industry experts debate whether AI has entered a new phase. Discussions span technical evolution, commercialization, and investment trends. Some argue that large model capabilities are converging and application innovation will drive the next wave; others warn of lingering bubbles and that truly valuable applications are just beginning. Either way, this conversation offers crucial insights for practitioners. If you're contemplating the next direction in AI, this is a must-read.

items.title: Agent 想用但不敢用？百度智能云企业级 Agent 安全落地实践｜AICon深圳
items.summary_zh: 百度智能云在 AICon 深圳大会上分享了企业级 Agent 安全落地的实践经验，直面当前企业“想用 Agent 又担心风险”的普遍痛点。他们提出了一套从身份认证、数据隔离到行为审计的完整安全框架，并结合百度内部的真实业务场景进行了验证。通过将安全能力嵌入 Agent 的开发和运行全流程，百度智能云帮助客户在享受 AI 带来的效率提升的同时，有效防范数据泄露和权限滥用。这对于正在尝试部署 Agent 但被安全顾虑困扰的团队来说，是一份可参考的实战指南。
items.summary_en: At AICon Shenzhen, Baidu AI Cloud shared practical experience in securing enterprise-level agents, addressing the common dilemma of wanting to use AI agents but fearing risks. They presented a comprehensive security framework covering identity authentication, data isolation, and behavior auditing, validated through real Baidu internal use cases. By embedding security into the entire agent development and runtime lifecycle, Baidu helps customers achieve productivity gains from AI while preventing data leaks and privilege abuse. This is a valuable reference for teams struggling with security concerns when deploying agents.

items.title: Pinecone 推出 Nexus 引擎：为 AI 智能体整合业务上下文并生成结构化数据
items.summary_zh: Pinecone 发布了全新的 Nexus 引擎，旨在为 AI 智能体整合业务上下文并生成结构化数据。Nexus 能够自动连接企业内部的各类数据源，包括数据库、文档、API 等，构建起一个动态的上下文知识库，然后以结构化格式提供给智能体使用。这解决了当前智能体在复杂业务场景中“缺乏上下文理解”的核心痛点，让 AI 不仅可以回答问题，还能做出基于真实业务数据的决策。对于构建企业级知识助手和自动化工作流的团队来说，Nexus 提供了一层关键的基础设施能力。
items.summary_en: Pinecone has launched Nexus, a new engine designed to integrate business context for AI agents and generate structured data. Nexus automatically connects to internal data sources like databases, documents, and APIs, building a dynamic contextual knowledge base that it serves to agents in a structured format. This addresses a core pain point of current agents: lack of business context understanding. With Nexus, AI can not only answer questions but also make decisions grounded in real business data. For teams building enterprise knowledge assistants or automated workflows, Nexus provides critical infrastructure that bridges raw data and intelligent action.

items.title: 你的数据是否已为 AI-Ready？用这套框架找到答案 ｜技术实践
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章介绍了一套实用的框架，帮助组织评估自己的数据是否已为人工智能应用做好准备。框架从数据质量、标注完整性、格式标准化、隐私合规和访问控制等多个维度进行打分，最终给出一个“AI-Ready”指数。作者强调，许多企业在急于上马 AI 项目时往往忽略了底层数据的状况，导致模型效果不佳甚至失败。通过这个框架，团队可以系统性地识别数据短板，优先改进，从而让 AI 投资真正产生价值。适合数据工程师、AI 项目经理和首席数据官阅读。
items.summary_en: This article presents a practical framework for organizations to assess whether their data is truly ready for AI applications. It scores data across dimensions such as quality, annotation completeness, format standardization, privacy compliance, and access control, producing an 'AI-Ready' index. The author argues that many companies rush into AI projects without checking their data foundation, leading to poor model performance or failure. Using this framework, teams can systematically identify data weaknesses and prioritize improvements, ensuring AI investments deliver real value. It's a must-read for data engineers, AI project managers, and chief data officers.

items.title: 从“卷模型”到“算总账”：AI 产业竞争开始拼什么 | 请回答 WAIC 2026
items.summary_zh: 在WAIC 2026的讨论中，AI产业的竞争焦点正从单纯“卷模型”参数量转向“算总账”的综合成本与效益。这意味着企业不再只比拼谁的模型更大，而是更关注算力、数据、部署、运维等全链路的总拥有成本。对于技术决策者而言，理解这种转变有助于选择更可持续的AI战略，避免陷入盲目追求规模的陷阱。
items.summary_en: At WAIC 2026, the conversation shifted from obsessing over model size to evaluating the total cost of AI ownership — including computation, data, deployment, and maintenance. This means companies are no longer competing solely on parameter counts; they now care about long-term sustainability and ROI. For tech leaders, understanding this trend helps craft smarter AI strategies that avoid the trap of scale-at-all-costs.

items.title: Java 近期新闻：值对象、WildFly 41、TornadoVM、LangChain4j、Oracle AI Agent Studio
items.summary_zh: 这一期Java新闻涵盖了多项关键进展：值对象提案推进了Java的数据建模方式，WildFly 41带来了Jakarta EE的最新支持，TornadoVM让Java代码能在GPU上加速执行，LangChain4j则为Java开发者提供了便捷的LLM集成能力，而Oracle AI Agent Studio展示了企业级AI代理的开发平台。对Java生态来说，这些更新意味着更现代的语言特性、更高效的运行时以及更丰富的AI工具链。
items.summary_en: This roundup covers several Java ecosystem updates: the value objects proposal advances Java's data modeling, WildFly 41 brings latest Jakarta EE support, TornadoVM enables GPU acceleration for Java code, LangChain4j offers easy LLM integration for Java developers, and Oracle AI Agent Studio provides a platform for building enterprise AI agents. Together, these developments mean Java gains more modern language features, better performance options, and a richer AI toolkit — valuable for both backend engineers and enterprise architects.

items.title: Claude Opus 5
items.author: alvis
items.summary_zh: Claude Opus 5是Anthropic最新发布的大型语言模型，据称在推理、代码生成和多轮对话能力上实现了显著飞跃。相比前代，它更擅长处理长上下文和复杂指令，同时保持了较高的安全性。对于需要强大AI助手进行编程、写作及分析的开发者与研究者来说，这代表了一项重要的生产力提升工具。
items.summary_en: Claude Opus 5 is Anthropic's latest large language model, boasting major improvements in reasoning, code generation, and multi-turn conversation. It handles longer contexts and complex instructions more adeptly while maintaining strong safety guardrails. For developers and researchers seeking a powerful AI assistant for coding, writing, and analysis, this release marks a significant leap in productivity.

items.title: OpenAI and Hugging Face address security incident during model evaluation
items.author: mfiguiere
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 与 Hugging Face 联合披露了一起在模型评估过程中发现的安全事件，涉及潜在的数据泄露风险。两家公司迅速响应，修补了漏洞并加强了评估流程的防护措施。这一事件突显了 AI 模型评估环节的安全性不容忽视，特别是在第三方协作和开放测试环境中，更需要建立严格的安全审查机制。
items.summary_en: OpenAI and Hugging Face disclosed a security incident that occurred during a model evaluation, involving potential data exposure risks. Both companies responded quickly, patching the vulnerability and reinforcing security protocols in the evaluation pipeline. This incident highlights that AI model evaluation stages are not immune to attacks, especially in collaborative and open-testing environments, underscoring the need for rigorous security review processes to protect sensitive data.

items.title: Writing by hand is good for your brain
items.author: dwwoelfel
items.summary_zh: 最新的神经科学研究再次证实，手写比打字更能激活大脑中负责学习和记忆的区域。当人们用笔在纸上写字时，手部精细动作与视觉、空间感知的协同作用能加深对信息的处理，从而提升理解和长期记忆。对于学生、创意工作者以及任何希望提高学习效率的人来说，暂时放下键盘、拿起纸笔可能是一种简单而有效的认知训练。
items.summary_en: Recent neuroscience research reaffirms that handwriting engages the brain's learning and memory centers far more deeply than typing. The coordinated fine motor movements, visual feedback, and spatial awareness involved in putting pen to paper enhance information processing, leading to better comprehension and long-term retention. For students, creatives, and anyone seeking to learn more effectively, this suggests that swapping the keyboard for a notebook now and then is a simple yet powerful cognitive boost.

items.title: Terence Tao's ChatGPT conversation about the Jacobian Conjecture counterexample
items.author: gmays
items.summary_zh: 数学界著名的陶哲轩最近分享了他与 ChatGPT 关于雅可比猜想反例的对话记录。这不仅仅是技术演示，更展示了大型语言模型如何辅助顶尖数学家进行前沿研究。ChatGPT 帮助他梳理思路、验证推理过程，甚至可能提出新的视角。对于数学爱好者和 AI 研究者来说，这是一个绝佳的案例，说明 AI 正从计算工具进化为真正的科研伙伴。
items.summary_en: Renowned mathematician Terrence Tao recently shared his conversation with ChatGPT about a potential counterexample to the Jacobian Conjecture. This is more than a tech demo—it shows how large language models can assist top-tier researchers in cutting-edge mathematics. ChatGPT helped him organize thoughts, verify reasoning, and perhaps even suggest new angles. For math enthusiasts and AI researchers, it's a compelling case study of AI evolving from a calculator into a genuine research collaborator.

items.title: Startup founders urge U.S. government not to shut off Chinese open weight AI
items.author: theanonymousone
items.summary_zh: 一群创业公司的创始人联合向美国政府发出呼吁，请求不要切断中国开源AI模型的访问渠道。他们认为，中国团队开发的开放权重模型（如Qwen、Llama的中国衍生版）为全球AI生态注入了竞争与多样性，阻断它们将损害技术创新，并迫使全球开发者依赖少数封闭平台。这一呼声凸显了AI开源社区对地缘政治干预的真实忧虑。
items.summary_en: A group of startup founders has urged the U.S. government not to block access to Chinese open-weight AI models, arguing that models like Qwen and derivative Llama variants contribute crucial competition and diversity to the global AI ecosystem. They warn that cutting off these models would stifle innovation and force developers towards a handful of closed platforms. The plea underscores growing anxiety within the open-source community over geopolitical tensions threatening cross-border AI collaboration.

items.title: Android May Soon Restrict On-Device ADB
items.author: shscs911
items.summary_zh: 有消息称Android可能很快会限制设备上的ADB（Android调试桥）功能。这一变化主要是出于安全考虑，因为恶意应用常利用ADB权限进行静默安装或数据窃取。但限制也会影响开发者和高级用户，他们依赖本地ADB进行快速调试和自动化测试。如果你经常通过USB或无线ADB连接设备进行开发，需要留意后续的Android版本是否会收紧这一功能。
items.summary_en: Reports suggest Android may soon restrict on-device ADB access to improve security, as malicious apps often abuse ADB permissions for silent installations or data theft. However, this change could impact developers and power users who rely on local ADB for convenient debugging and automation. If you frequently use ADB over USB or Wi-Fi for development, keep an eye on upcoming Android releases — they might require alternative methods like remote debugging through authorized hosts.

items.title: If coding has been solved, why does software keep getting worse?
items.author: pchm
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章挑战了“AI已经解决了编程问题”的流行叙事，反问：如果编码真的被“解决”了，为什么软件质量反而越来越差？作者指出，AI代码助手虽然能快速生成大量代码，但缺乏对软件架构、可维护性和长期可靠性的理解，导致技术债务积累。而且，糟糕的需求和设计决策才是软件变坏的根源，而这些靠自动补全根本无法解决。对于开发者而言，这提醒我们不要盲目迷信AI，而应坚持良好的工程实践。
items.summary_en: This article pushes back against the claim that AI has solved coding, asking why software keeps getting worse if that were true. The author argues that AI code assistants generate plenty of code quickly but lack understanding of architecture, maintainability, and long-term reliability, leading to technical debt. Worse, bad requirements and design decisions — not the act of writing code — are the real cause of software degradation, and autocomplete won't fix that. Developers are reminded to not blindly trust AI and to uphold good engineering practices.

items.title: It's getting harder to focus every day
items.author: peykar
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了现代人越来越难以集中注意力的现象，分析了社交媒体无休止推送、碎片化信息过载以及多任务工作文化对大脑专注力的侵蚀。作者指出，这不仅是个人自律问题，更是数字环境设计导致的系统性困境，并呼吁重新审视工作工具和日常习惯以保护深度思考能力。
items.summary_en: This piece dives into the growing struggle to maintain focus in a distraction-saturated world. It blames endless social media feeds, information overload, and multitasking culture for eroding our attention spans. More than a personal willpower issue, the author argues it's a systemic problem of digital environment design, urging a rethink of tools and habits to preserve deep thinking.

items.title: AI Companies Are Trying to Hide a Staggering Amount of Debt
items.author: technewssss
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章揭露了AI公司看似风光背后隐藏的巨额债务问题，包括未披露的硬件采购欠款、数据中心建设贷款以及人才薪资泡沫。随着融资环境收紧，这种隐性负债可能成为压垮许多初创公司的隐患。它警示投资者和从业者，不应只关注模型能力，还要审视公司真正的财务健康度。
items.summary_en: This article shines a light on the staggering hidden debts AI companies are carrying—undisclosed hardware procurement bills, data center construction loans, and inflated talent costs. As funding tightens, these liabilities could become ticking time bombs for startups. It's a stark reminder for investors and practitioners to look beyond model benchmarks and examine financial health.

items.title: India's first privately-developed rocket reaches orbit on debut launch
items.author: sohkamyung
items.summary_zh: 印度首枚由私营公司开发的火箭在首次发射中成功进入轨道，这标志着印度航天产业的重要转折点。该火箭由Skyroot Aerospace打造，名为Vikram-S，它验证了低成本、高响应的发射能力，也为全球对印度商业航天领域的投资注入了信心。对于航天爱好者和潜在的卫星运营商来说，这意味着未来多了一个可靠的发射选项，尤其适用于小型卫星的快速部署。
items.summary_en: India's first privately-developed rocket successfully reached orbit on its debut launch, marking a major milestone for the country's space industry. Built by Skyroot Aerospace and named Vikram-S, the rocket demonstrated low-cost, responsive launch capabilities, boosting confidence in India's commercial space sector. For space enthusiasts and satellite operators, this means a new reliable option for deploying small satellites quickly and affordably, potentially reshaping the global launch market.

items.title: PromptQL
items.description: Multiplayer AI that replaces Slack
items.summary_zh: PromptQL 是一款多用户协作AI工具，号称要取代Slack。它让团队成员可以在同一个AI对话中实时协作，共同查询数据、生成内容或解决问题。对于需要频繁沟通和共享AI结果的团队来说，PromptQL 将聊天与AI能力无缝融合，提升协作效率。
items.summary_en: PromptQL is a multiplayer AI chat platform designed to replace Slack for team collaboration. It allows multiple users to interact with the same AI in real-time, sharing queries, results, and context. This transforms team communication by embedding AI assistance directly into conversations, making it easier to solve problems collectively. It's particularly valuable for data-driven teams that need quick answers and collaborative analysis.

items.title: Teable 3.0
items.description: AI Spreadsheet for Business
items.summary_zh: Teable 3.0 将AI能力注入电子表格，打造面向企业的智能数据处理平台。它不仅能自动分析数据、生成图表，还能基于自然语言指令完成复杂运算。对于需要快速洞察数据的企业用户来说，Teable 让数据分析从专业操作变成日常对话。
items.summary_en: Teable 3.0 is an AI-powered spreadsheet designed for business users. It integrates intelligent data analysis, natural language querying, and automated chart generation directly into the familiar spreadsheet interface. This tool helps business professionals gain insights without needing advanced data skills, making data-driven decision making accessible to everyone in an organization.

items.title: Fedica 2.0
items.description: Publish and grow your profile across social apps
items.summary_zh: Fedica 2.0是一款跨社交平台的内容发布和账号增长工具，支持在多个社交应用上统一管理和定时发布内容，同时提供数据分析来帮助用户扩大影响力。对于社交媒体运营者、品牌营销人员以及个人创作者来说，它简化了多平台维护的繁琐流程，让你可以更专注于内容本身。新版本可能加入了更智能的排程和增长建议，是提升社交效率的得力助手。
items.summary_en: Fedica 2.0 is a cross-platform social media tool designed to help users publish and grow their profiles across various social apps. It centralizes content scheduling, posting, and analytics, making it easier for social media managers, marketers, and creators to maintain a consistent presence. The update promises smarter scheduling and growth insights, solving the pain point of managing multiple accounts. By streamlining workflows and providing actionable data, Fedica 2.0 helps users save time and build a larger, more engaged audience.

items.title: Pushary
items.description: Approve AI requests from your lock screen
items.summary_zh: Pushary是一款创新的工具，让你直接从手机锁屏上批准AI发出的请求，无需解锁设备。这种设计大幅提升了效率，特别适合那些频繁需要授权AI代理访问数据或执行操作的场景，比如自动化工作流或智能家居控制。对于依赖AI助手的用户来说，Pushary简化了交互流程，将审批过程变得像查看通知一样快速便捷，既安全又省时。
items.summary_en: Pushary is an innovative app that lets you approve AI requests directly from your lock screen without unlocking your phone. It streamlines the interaction with AI agents, allowing for quick authorization of actions like data access or task execution. This is especially useful for users who rely on automated workflows or smart home controls, where fast approvals are needed. By turning the approval process into a simple lock-screen notification, Pushary enhances both security and efficiency, making AI interactions feel more natural and less intrusive.

items.title: Codex 穷鬼大救星
items.description: 穷则思变，富则...算了，富哥就不用看这篇文章了！ 为了守护我们钱包，这套穷鬼工作流横空出世！ 欢迎来到 AI 黑心包工队！
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章介绍了一套名为“穷鬼工作流”的AI编程方案，旨在帮助预算有限的开发者利用Codex等工具低成本完成项目。作者以幽默自嘲的口吻，将这套方案比作“AI黑心包工队”，强调其核心价值是让手头拮据的程序员也能享受AI带来的效率提升，而不必购买昂贵的付费服务。对于个人开发者和小团队尤其实用。
items.summary_en: This article introduces a budget-friendly AI coding workflow called "Poor Guy Workflow," aimed at helping developers with limited funds leverage tools like Codex to complete projects at low cost. The author humorously dubs it an "AI shady contractor team," emphasizing that it allows coders on a tight budget to enjoy AI efficiency boosts without expensive subscriptions. It's especially practical for indie developers and small teams.

items.title: PodcastorAI
items.description: Your AI twin hosts your video podcast
items.summary_zh: PodcastorAI 能创建你的AI数字分身，让它代替你主持视频播客。你只需提供素材，AI就能模拟你的声音、表情和风格，自动生成完整的播客节目。这对于忙碌的内容创作者或希望规模化生产播客的人来说，可以大幅节省录制时间，同时保持个人品牌一致性。
items.summary_en: PodcastorAI creates an AI twin that can host your video podcast on your behalf. By training on your voice, face, and style, the AI generates a full podcast episode with your digital avatar, saving hours of recording time. This is perfect for busy content creators or brands wanting to scale podcast production while maintaining a personal touch. It also enables creators to repurpose written content into engaging video podcasts automatically.

items.title: Fluree AI
items.description: Give every AI agent trusted context
items.summary_zh: Fluree AI致力于为每个AI代理提供可信的上下文数据，确保人工智能决策基于可靠和经过验证的信息源。在AI应用日益普及的今天，模型幻觉和错误数据是主要痛点。Fluree AI通过构建可信的数据基础，帮助开发者在构建智能代理时减少虚构信息，提升回答的准确性。对于企业级AI部署而言，它提供了一种机制来保证AI输出的可信度，特别适合金融、医疗等对数据准确性要求极高的领域。
items.summary_en: Fluree AI aims to give every AI agent trusted context by providing a reliable and verifiable data foundation. As AI agents become more common, ensuring they base their decisions on accurate information is crucial to avoiding hallucinations and errors. Fluree AI solves this by integrating trusted data sources directly into the AI pipeline, allowing developers to build agents that produce more trustworthy outputs. This is particularly valuable for enterprise applications in finance, healthcare, and legal sectors where data integrity is paramount. By grounding AI in verified context, Fluree AI enhances reliability and reduces risk.

items.title: CrawlRaven
items.description: SEO Hub for GSC + GA4 + a 200-point crawl
items.summary_zh: CrawlRaven是一个一站式SEO中心，整合了Google Search Console和GA4数据，并提供200项网站健康度扫描。对于SEO从业者来说，它免去了在多个平台间切换的麻烦，将搜索排名数据、流量分析和页面审核统一在一个界面中。其爬虫功能会检查200个关键指标，帮助发现技术SEO问题。无论是优化关键词还是排查网站错误，CrawlRaven都能提供清晰的数据洞察，让SEO工作更加高效和系统化。
items.summary_en: CrawlRaven is an all-in-one SEO hub that integrates Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 data, along with a comprehensive 200-point website crawl. It eliminates the need to switch between multiple tools by consolidating search performance, traffic analytics, and site audits into a single dashboard. The crawl checks 200 critical health indicators, helping SEO professionals and site owners identify technical issues that impact rankings. With its unified view, CrawlRaven simplifies data analysis and makes it easier to optimize for search engines, saving time and improving overall site health.

items.title: Heard
items.description: Give Claude Code and Codex a voice
items.summary_zh: Heard是一款为Claude Code和Codex等AI编程工具增添语音交互功能的插件，开发者可以用语音下达编码指令，从而减少键盘输入，提升工作效率。它对追求快速迭代和更自然开发体验的程序员尤其有用，让AI编程助手真正“开口说话”。
items.summary_en: Heard is a tool that gives a voice to AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex. It allows developers to issue commands and interact with these tools using natural speech, reducing the need for manual typing and speeding up workflows. This is especially valuable for developers who want faster iteration and a more fluid, hands-free coding experience, effectively turning their AI pair programmer into a conversational partner.

items.title: FluentDB
items.description: The AI database client for Mac
items.summary_zh: FluentDB是一款专为Mac设计的AI数据库客户端，通过自然语言处理让用户能用日常英语查询数据库，并提供智能建议来优化操作。它降低了数据库使用的技术门槛，使非技术人员也能轻松访问数据，同时为专业开发者和数据分析师提供了更高效的交互方式。
items.summary_en: FluentDB is an AI-powered database client built specifically for Mac. It leverages natural language processing to let users query databases using plain English, while also offering intelligent suggestions for query optimization. By lowering the technical barrier to database interaction, it empowers non-technical users to access data effortlessly, and provides developers and data analysts with a faster, more intuitive workflow.

items.title: The new Firecrawl /search
items.description: Our most accurate Search API for AI agents.
items.summary_zh: Firecrawl推出的全新/search API专为AI代理打造，号称目前最精准的网页搜索接口，能从互联网中提取结构化数据并返回可靠结果。它解决了AI应用在实时信息获取时常见的噪声和不可靠性问题，对构建智能助手和自动化工具的开发者至关重要。
items.summary_en: The new Firecrawl /search API is designed specifically for AI agents, offering what is claimed to be the most accurate search endpoint available. It extracts structured data from the web and returns clean, reliable results, solving the issues of noise and unreliability that often plague AI applications needing real-time information. This makes it essential for developers building intelligent assistants, automation tools, or any system that depends on fresh, precise web data.

items.title: 小程序上线半年我赚了多少钱？
items.description: 1. 开发历程 时间过得真快，转眼间福猪记账小程序上线已经有半年时间了，从v1.0.0 版本做到了 v1.6.1 版本。今天整理了开发日志，真的不敢相信自己在工作之余能够把它做出来并上线。 2.用户积
items.summary_zh: 一位独立开发者分享了他业余开发的记账小程序“福猪记账”上线半年来的真实收入与运营数据。从v1.0.0迭代到v1.6.1，他记录了开发日志、用户增长曲线和盈利情况。这篇文章不仅展示了个人开发者利用业余时间做产品的可能性，也提供了从零到一、从技术到商业的完整复盘，特别适合想试试副业的程序员参考。
items.summary_en: An indie developer shared the real revenue and operational data of his expense tracking mini-program called 'Fuzhu' over six months since launch. He iterated from v1.0.0 to v1.6.1, documenting development logs, user growth, and profitability. This article demonstrates the possibility of building a product in spare time, offering a complete postmortem from coding to business. It’s especially useful for programmers exploring side projects.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者从Cursor切换到Amazon Codex使用了半个多月，分享了两者的本质差异。Cursor让他第一次感受到AI编程的震撼，但Codex让他真正觉得AI不再只是辅助工具，而是一个能独立执行任务的超级Agent。作者认为Codex更接近下一阶段AI编程的形态，从对话式补全进化到主动式代理，对追求最前沿编程体验的开发者有重要参考价值。
items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Amazon Codex for over half a month, a developer shared their real experience of the fundamental differences. While Cursor first impressed them with AI-assisted coding, Codex felt like a true super agent that can independently execute tasks, not just an assistant. The author believes Codex represents the next phase of AI programming—evolving from conversational completion to proactive agency. This comparison is invaluable for developers seeking the cutting edge in AI-powered coding tools.

items.title: Vibe Coding 时代：Vue 消失了还是 React 太强？
items.description: Vibe Coding 时代：Vue 消失了还是 React 太强？ 作者：吴佳浩 撰稿时间：2026-3-28 最后更新：2026-3-30 引言： 最近一段时间，“vibe coding” 的项目
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了在Vibe Coding（基于AI情绪化编码）时代，Vue和React两大前端框架的地位变化。作者分析了为何有人认为Vue逐渐式微而React愈发强势，并指出AI编程工具可能更倾向于与React生态兼容。文章引发读者思考：在AI辅助编码日益普及的今天，前端开发者应如何选择技术栈，以及Vue是否真的面临生存危机。
items.summary_en: This article explores the shifting status of Vue and React in the era of Vibe Coding, where AI-assisted development is driven by mood and flow. The author analyzes why some believe Vue is fading while React grows stronger, noting that AI coding tools may favor React's ecosystem. It prompts readers to think about how frontend developers should choose their stack and whether Vue truly faces an existential threat as AI-assisted coding becomes mainstream.

items.title: 最近公司烧token比招员工还贵，老板干懵了...
items.description: 如题。 这真的没在开玩笑。 这也是最近不少公司，在大力、甚至全面拥抱 AI 之后所发出的切实吐槽。 一个月前，Uber 的 CTO 曾对外透露，公司自部署 CC 以来，内部有超 9 成的工程师在高频率
items.summary_zh: 这不是段子，是真实发生在许多公司里的窘境。随着全面拥抱AI，员工高频调用大模型API，公司的token消耗费用竟然超过了招聘新员工的成本。Uber的CTO曾透露，内部有超过九成的工程师在频繁使用AI服务。老板们面对账单直呼头疼：本来是降本增效的AI，怎么成了新的烧钱黑洞？
items.summary_en: This isn't a joke—it's a real dilemma many companies are facing. After wholeheartedly adopting AI, their token usage costs have actually surpassed the expense of hiring new employees. Uber's CTO revealed that over 90% of their engineers are using AI services heavily. Bosses are staring at the bills in shock: the technology that was supposed to reduce costs and boost efficiency has instead become a new money-burning black hole.

items.title: 停更的这一年，All In AI、陪媳妇生娃、还考了个研
items.description: 停更的这一年，All In AI、陪媳妇生娃、还考了个研 打开掘金 App，看了一眼自己的最近更新——停在了整整一年前。 不是不想写，是这一年确实被塞得太满了。如果非要用几个关键词来概括，那就是： A
items.summary_zh: 一位掘金作者停更一年后回归，分享了这段时间的密集经历：全力投入 AI 领域、陪伴妻子生娃、还抽空考了个研。文章以第一人称讲述了如何平衡工作、家庭与个人提升，展现了技术人在生活重大节点上的真实抉择。对面临类似境遇的读者来说，这是一个关于如何在巨大压力下仍坚持成长的真实故事。
items.summary_en: A Juejin author returns after a year-long hiatus, recounting a whirlwind period of diving headfirst into AI, supporting his wife through childbirth, and even squeezing in graduate school exams. Through first-person narration, he shares how he balanced career, family, and personal growth, offering a relatable and inspiring tale for developers navigating life’s major milestones while striving to keep improving.

items.title: 2026编程圈很火的10个Skills
items.description: 前言 最近编程圈最火的一个词，非 Skills 莫属。 不是指程序员的技术能力，而是指 AI 编程助手的“技能包” 。 一套让 AI 从“随缘写代码”变成“按流程交付”的标准化工作流模块。 今天这篇文
items.summary_zh: 2026 年编程圈热议的 10 个 Skills 并非指程序员的技术能力，而是 AI 编程助手的“技能包”——一套标准化工作流模块，让 AI 从随缘写代码变为按流程交付。这些技能包覆盖代码审查、测试生成、文档编写等环节，旨在提升开发效率和代码质量。对正在探索 AI 辅助编程的团队和个人开发者而言，掌握这些技能包将成为提高生产力的关键。
items.summary_en: The 10 hottest Skills in programming circles for 2026 refer not to developers' own abilities but to standardized workflow modules for AI coding assistants. These skill packages transform AI from random code generation to structured delivery, covering code review, test generation, documentation, and more. For teams and individual developers exploring AI-assisted programming, mastering these skills is becoming essential for boosting productivity and code quality.

items.title: Kimi k3是真碉，但太不经用，也有拉跨点！
items.description: K3 已测，确实强，但要命的是配额太少了！ 一天不到，一周的配额已经烧完了，大概就生成了 5 个测试页面！ 从五个例子中，可以知道，有些确实很强，有些呢又差点意思，有些比较糟糕。 我不是那种收钱办事儿
items.summary_zh: Kimi 的 K3 模型实测表现确实强悍，但致命缺陷是配额太少，一周的额度在一天内就用完了，只生成了五个测试页面。从这几个例子看，有的生成效果很棒，有的却不尽如人意，甚至有些糟糕。作者强调自己并非收钱办事，而是真实体验，这让 K3 的实际可用性打了折扣。
items.summary_en: The author tested Kimi's K3 model and found it genuinely powerful, but the critical issue is its extremely limited quota. A week's worth of quota was exhausted in just one day, allowing only five test page generations. Among the examples, some results were impressive while others were disappointing or even poor. The author stresses this is an unbiased review, highlighting that K3, despite its strength, suffers from severe availability constraints that undermine its practical use.

items.title: 盘点 18 个 Kimi K3 外网爆火的案例，太令人惊艳了。
items.description: 这个周末可太热闹了。 因为 Kimi K3 的发布，外网对这个模型的讨论非常热烈。总结来讲： ① 总参数达到 2.8 万亿， 目前最大的开源模型，100 万上下文，原生支持视觉理解。
items.summary_zh: 最近Kimi K3的发布引爆了外网讨论，这款开源模型总参数高达2.8万亿，成为目前最大的开源模型，支持百万级别的上下文长度，并且原生集成了视觉理解能力。文中盘点了18个惊艳案例，展示了它在长文档处理、多模态推理等场景的突破，让开发者们看到开源大模型的新高度。
items.summary_en: The release of Kimi K3 has ignited heated discussions abroad. This open-source model boasts an enormous 2.8 trillion total parameters, making it the largest open-source model to date. It supports a million-token context window and natively integrates visual understanding. The article highlights 18 impressive use cases that demonstrate its breakthroughs in long-document processing and multimodal reasoning, offering developers a glimpse into the new frontier of open-source large language models.

items.title: 拓扑管网 3D 可视化大屏demo：科技感（地图 + 拓扑 + 3D 空间）
items.description: 这是一套**以科技感与炫酷视觉为第一目标**的 3D 数据大屏 Demo：在真实地理底图之上，叠加供热管网拓扑与 3D 空间管路，呈现"地图 + 拓扑 + 3D"一体的可视化效果。
items.summary_zh: 这是一款极具科技感的3D数据大屏Demo，它在真实地理地图上叠加了供热管网的拓扑结构和三维空间管路，实现了“地图+拓扑+3D”融合的可视化效果。它专为炫酷视觉而设计，能帮助运维人员或管理者一目了然地掌握管网布局与运行状态，对于智慧城市和工业数字化场景十分有价值。
items.summary_en: This is a sci-fi styled 3D data dashboard demo that overlays heating network topology and spatial pipelines on a real geographic map, creating a combined map-topology-3D visualization. Designed for impressive visuals, it helps operators or managers grasp the entire network layout and status at a glance, making it valuable for smart city and industrial digitalization scenarios.

items.title: 如何看待月之暗面发布 kimi K3-256K 大模型，能力和 K3 一样，不能看视频，上下文只有 256K？
items.summary_zh: 月之暗面发布了Kimi K3-256K大模型，能力与原有的K3相同，但上下文窗口限制为256K并取消了视频处理功能。这被视为在成本与性能之间的妥协，为不需要视频能力但需要长上下文的用户提供了一个更轻量化的选项，但也引发了社区关于为何不直接使用原版的讨论。
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI released the Kimi K3-256K large language model, which retains the same core capabilities as the original K3 but reduces the context window to 256K tokens and removes video processing support. This appears to be a cost-performance trade-off, offering a leaner alternative for users who need long-context handling but not multimodal video features. The move has sparked community debate about whether the stripped-down version is necessary when the full K3 already exists.

items.title: 英伟达与 SK 集团推出超 5000 亿美元双向交易 AI 合作计划，英伟达买内存，SK 买超算，如何解读？
items.summary_zh: 英伟达与SK集团宣布了一项超过5000亿美元的双向交易AI合作计划：英伟达购买SK的内存产品，SK购买英伟达的超算系统。这一大规模合作旨在稳固关键供应链、加速AI基础设施建设，同时凸显了计算与存储技术之间日益加深的相互依赖关系。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA and SK Group announced a landmark AI cooperation plan valued at over $500 billion, featuring a two-way trade: NVIDIA will purchase memory products from SK, while SK will acquire supercomputing systems from NVIDIA. The partnership is designed to secure critical supply chains and accelerate AI infrastructure development. It highlights the growing interdependence between AI compute and memory technologies, and is expected to have profound impacts on the global chip and memory markets.

items.title: AI 会让艺术「更繁荣」还是「更廉价」？
items.summary_zh: AI在艺术创作领域的崛起引发了深刻讨论：它究竟是让艺术变得更有活力、催生新表达形式，还是让创作变得廉价、失去独特性？一方面，AI降低了门槛，普通人也能生成精美作品；另一方面，大量低质内容泛滥，威胁传统艺术家的生计。这个问题不仅关乎技术，更触及艺术本质——当机器能模仿风格，人类的创意和情感是否还是不可替代的核心？值得每位创作者和观众思考。
items.summary_en: The rise of AI in art has sparked a heated debate: does it make art more vibrant by democratizing creation and enabling new forms, or does it cheapen it by flooding the market with mass-produced, soulless pieces? On one hand, anyone can now generate stunning visuals with a prompt; on the other, traditional artists struggle to compete with the volume and speed of AI output. This touches the very essence of what we value in art—uniqueness, human emotion, and the story behind the work. As AI blurs the line between creator and tool, we must ask whether art becomes more accessible or simply more disposable. It's a pivotal conversation for artists, tech enthusiasts, and anyone who believes in the power of human creativity.

items.title: 男生中考 699 分偷偷改志愿读中职，称「未来想当程序员，AI 时代也不怕」，如何看待这一升学选择？
items.summary_zh: 一名中考699分（高分）的男生瞒着家人把志愿改成中职，理由是希望尽早学习编程技能，认为在AI时代实用技术比学历更重要。这一反传统选择引发热议：放弃普高走职教道路，是明智的个性化规划还是风险过大的冒险？事件折射出社会对职业教育认知的转变——当AI冲击传统岗位，扎实的技能或许比一纸文凭更能抵御未来不确定性。这种勇气和远见值得探讨，也挑战了“唯学历论”的固有观念。
items.summary_en: A middle school graduate with an impressive score of 699 out of 750 secretly changed his application to a vocational school instead of a top high school, stating he wants to become a programmer and believes practical skills matter more than a traditional academic path in the AI era. This bold move has stirred heated discussions: is it a smart, future-focused choice or a risky gamble? It highlights a growing shift in how people view vocational education—as AI automates many jobs, hands-on technical training might offer better job security than a university degree. The student's courage to defy societal expectations and plan his own career path is both inspiring and thought-provoking, challenging the long-held belief that only a college education leads to success.

items.title: 如何评价荣耀最新的 logo？为啥要在这个时间点更换 logo？
items.summary_zh: 荣耀近期更换品牌logo，新标识更简洁现代，去掉中文「荣耀」字样，仅保留英文「HONOR」并采用定制字体。此举正值荣耀独立三周年、定位高端全球化的关键节点。更换logo不仅是视觉升级，更是品牌重塑——适应国际市场竞争，强化科技与时尚感。对年轻用户和海外市场来说，新logo更简洁易记，传递了荣耀从华为剥离后独立发展的新魄力。
items.summary_en: Honor recently refreshed its logo, adopting a minimalist, modern design that drops the Chinese characters and uses a custom font for 'HONOR'. The timing coincides with the company's third anniversary of independence and its push into the global high-end market. The logo change isn't just about looks—it signals a strategic rebranding to appeal to international consumers and younger audiences, emphasizing technology and style. With a cleaner identity, Honor aims to strengthen its standalone presence and compete more effectively beyond its home market.

items.title: 宫本茂称做游戏别老想着回本，如何看待任天堂的开发理念？
items.summary_zh: 任天堂传奇制作人宫本茂指出，做游戏不应总把回本放在首位，而应专注于创造乐趣和独特体验。这一理念与任天堂长期以来坚持的“玩法至上”一脉相承——从《超级马里奥》到《塞尔达传说》，他们始终相信好游戏自然会赚钱。在当今游戏业追求氪金和快速变现的潮流下，这种“反商业”思维显得格外珍贵。它提醒开发者回归初心：只有真正让玩家快乐的作品，才能穿越周期、赢得口碑与长期成功。
items.summary_en: Nintendo legend Shigeru Miyamoto once said game developers should not always focus on recouping costs, but instead prioritize creating fun and unique experiences. This philosophy has long defined Nintendo's approach—from Super Mario to The Legend of Zelda, they believe that a great game will naturally generate profit. In an industry increasingly driven by microtransactions and short-term monetization, Miyamoto's words are a refreshing reminder that true success comes from delivering genuine joy to players. His stance challenges the prevailing profit-first mindset, suggesting that if you put creativity and player satisfaction at the core, financial returns will follow. For developers and gamers alike, it's a powerful call to return to what makes games special: imagination and pure entertainment.

items.title: Claude Code is steganographically marking requests
items.author: kirushik
items.summary_zh: Claude Code被发现会在发出的请求中嵌入隐写术标记，这一做法引发了广泛讨论。这些标记以不易察觉的方式隐藏在正常数据流里，可能用于追溯请求来源、防止篡改或进行版权声明。虽然隐写本身并非恶意，但它意味着用户与AI交互时可能被无感追踪，从而引发隐私和透明度方面的担忧。对于注重数据隐蔽性和控制权的开发者来说，这无疑是个需要警惕的新动向。
items.summary_en: Claude Code has been discovered to embed steganographic marks within its outgoing requests, a technique that hides data in plain sight. These marks can trace the origin of requests, prevent tampering, or assert copyright. While not inherently malicious, the practice raises privacy and transparency concerns, as users may be unknowingly tracked during AI interactions. For developers who value data sovereignty and fine-grained control, this revelation signals a need to scrutinize how AI tools handle metadata beyond the obvious outputs.

items.title: Android Developer Verification: Threat masquerading as protection
items.author: drewfax
items.summary_zh: 一位安全研究员揭露了 Android 开发者验证流程中存在的严重安全隐患：这一本意是保护开发者账户的机制，反而可能被攻击者利用来冒充合法开发者。通过分析验证逻辑中的漏洞，攻击者可以绕过程序窃取身份或发布恶意应用。这相当于把保护门禁变成了入侵的梯子。对于 Android 生态中的所有开发者而言，这个问题值得高度警惕，因为它动摇了整个应用签名和身份信任体系的基础。
items.summary_en: A security researcher reveals that Android's Developer Verification process—designed to protect developers—can be exploited by attackers to impersonate legitimate developers. By analyzing flaws in the verification logic, adversaries can bypass protections, steal identities, or distribute malicious apps under trusted names. This turns a protective gate into an entry point for intrusion. The finding undermines the trust foundation of Android's app signing and identity system, making it a critical concern for every developer in the ecosystem.

items.title: Apple sues OpenAI, accuses ex-employees of stealing trade secrets
items.author: stock_toaster
items.summary_zh: 苹果公司近日对OpenAI提起民事诉讼，指控多名前员工在离职时窃取了与人工智能研发相关的商业机密。这些员工据称带走了内部技术文档和核心算法，并可能用于竞争项目。这起诉讼不仅反映了硅谷两大科技巨头在人才和知识产权上的激烈争夺，也凸显了AI领域日益敏感的技术保密问题。对于科技行业观察者而言，这场法律战的结果或许会重塑企业防范员工跳槽时的保密协议设计。
items.summary_en: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that several former employees stole trade secrets related to artificial intelligence research. The complaint claims these workers took proprietary technical documents and core algorithms before leaving for positions that could benefit competing projects. This legal battle underscores the fierce competition for talent and intellectual property between two Silicon Valley giants, and highlights the growing sensitivity of technology secrecy in the AI industry. For tech observers, the outcome may influence how companies craft confidentiality agreements to guard against employee poaching.

items.title: EU Parliament greenlights Chat Control 1.0
items.author: rapnie
items.summary_zh: 欧盟议会通过了备受争议的Chat Control 1.0法案，要求数字平台扫描并报告涉及儿童性虐待材料的私密通信内容。这项立法引发了隐私与安全之间的激烈辩论，支持者认为它有助于保护儿童，而反对者警告这可能破坏端到端加密并开创大规模监控的先例。对于关注数字权利和隐私保护的群体来说，这是一个需要密切关注的发展。
items.summary_en: The European Parliament has approved the controversial Chat Control 1.0 regulation, requiring digital platforms to scan private communications for child sexual abuse material. The law sparks intense debate between child safety advocates and privacy defenders, who warn it undermines end-to-end encryption and sets a precedent for mass surveillance. Anyone concerned about digital rights and encryption should pay close attention to this development.

items.title: GPT-5.6
items.author: logickkk1
items.summary_zh: 关于GPT-5.6的传闻在开发者社区悄然升温，据称这是OpenAI内部测试的新一代模型，在推理效率和长文本处理上有显著提升。尽管官方未确认，但泄露的基准测试显示其在复杂编程和数学任务上超越了现有版本。如果属实，这将意味着AI模型在实用性和响应速度上迈入新台阶，对依赖语言模型的开发者和企业影响深远。
items.summary_en: Rumors about GPT-5.6, an alleged internal iteration from OpenAI, have sparked excitement in the developer community. Leaked benchmarks suggest it offers substantial improvements in reasoning efficiency and long-context handling, outperforming current models on complex coding and math tasks. While OpenAI hasn't confirmed the release, the speculation points to a possible leap in practical AI utility, making responses faster and more accurate. For developers and businesses relying on language models, even incremental upgrades can translate into better user experiences and lower latency. This potential release underscores the rapid pace of AI advancement.

items.title: Decoding the obfuscated bash script on a Uniqlo t-shirt
items.author: speerer
items.summary_zh: 一位技术爱好者解析了优衣库T恤上印制的混淆bash脚本，发现它实际上是一个恶作剧程序，通过复杂的字符串操作和陷阱逻辑来隐藏其真实功能。这篇分析展示了逆向工程乐趣，也提醒大家即使看似无害的代码也可能暗藏玄机。对于安全研究人员和编程爱好者来说，这是一次趣味与技术并重的解谜之旅。
items.summary_en: A tech enthusiast meticulously dissected an obfuscated bash script printed on a Uniqlo t-shirt, revealing it to be a playful prank program designed to confuse casual observers. The script uses intricate string manipulations and trap commands to mask its true purpose, which is simply to echo a message. This analysis highlights the fun side of reverse engineering and serves as a reminder that even innocuous-looking code can contain hidden complexity. It's a delightful read for security researchers and programming hobbyists who enjoy a good puzzle.
